question: Should OpenClaw accept this CLI catalog as a core public CLI/plugin/prompt surface now, split it into narrower reviewable layers, or keep it as an RFC/prototype for later?
rationale: The branch intentionally adds user-facing CLI commands, plugin descriptor fields, docs/fixtures, scripts, and prompt behavior, so code review cannot choose the permanent product/API boundary without maintainer intent.

options.title: Split And Review Direction First
options.body: Keep the draft open and ask for a staged plan that separates a stable CLI read path from plugin API and prompt changes before merge.

options.title: Accept As Experimental Core Surface
options.body: Maintainership can explicitly sponsor the broad surface and require compatibility docs, conflict resolution, and live proof before landing.

options.title: Pause Or Close The Prototype
options.body: If this catalog is not wanted in core now, pause or close the branch and keep design discussion in the linked RFC until sponsored.

recommendation.title: Split And Review Direction First
recommendation.body: Keep the draft open and ask for a staged plan that separates a stable CLI read path from plugin API and prompt changes before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is the best available routing owner from current-main PR history for the central CLI/plugin/prompt paths and product/API boundary decision.
